question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

He wore a __bizarre __outfit for the party.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Weird**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"bizarre"** means something that is very strange or unusual in style, appearance, or general character. (अजीब)

 
 
• **Example: **The museum had a collection of bizarre masks from around the world.
 
 

 
• **"Weird" **also refers to something that is strange and unusual, often in a way that is unsettling or hard to understand. (अजीब)

 
 
• **Example: **She has a weird habit of speaking to herself when she's concentrating on her work.
